## Editing boundary

The full ID is `<path>#<D-or-C-ID>`.

For every path, retain immutable-before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require all remaining ASTs equal.
